64: 	@Override public void handle(AnnotationValues<UtilityClass> annotation, JCAnnotation ast, JavacNode annotationNode) {
65: 		handleExperimentalFlagUsage(annotationNode, ConfigurationKeys.UTILITY_CLASS_FLAG_USAGE, "@UtilityClass");
66: 		
67: 		deleteAnnotationIfNeccessary(annotationNode, UtilityClass.class);
68: 		
69: 		JavacNode typeNode = annotationNode.up();
70: 		if (!checkLegality(typeNode, annotationNode)) return;
71: 		changeModifiersAndGenerateConstructor(annotationNode.up(), annotationNode);
72: 	}
73: 	
74: 	private static boolean checkLegality(JavacNode typeNode, JavacNode errorNode) {
75: 		if (!isClass(typeNode)) {
76: 			errorNode.addError("@UtilityClass is only supported on a class.");
77: 			return false;
78: 		}
79: 		
80: 		// It might be an inner class. This is okay, but only if it is / can be a static inner class. Thus, all of its parents have to be static inner classes until the top-level.
81: 		JavacNode typeWalk = typeNode;
82: 		while (true) {
83: 			typeWalk = typeWalk.up();
84: 			switch (typeWalk.getKind()) {
85: 			case TYPE:
86: 				JCClassDecl typeDef = (JCClassDecl) typeWalk.get();
87: 				if ((typeDef.mods.flags & (Flags.STATIC | Flags.ANNOTATION | Flags.ENUM | Flags.INTERFACE)) != 0) continue;
88: 				if (typeWalk.up().getKind() == Kind.COMPILATION_UNIT) return true;
89: 				errorNode.addError("@UtilityClass automatically makes the class static, however, this class cannot be made static.");
90: 				return false;
91: 			case COMPILATION_UNIT:
92: 				return true;
93: 			default:
94: 				errorNode.addError("@UtilityClass cannot be placed on a method local or anonymous inner class, or any class nested in such a class.");
95: 				return false;
96: 			}
97: 		}
98: 	}

102: 		
103: 		boolean makeConstructor = true;
104: 		
105: 		classDecl.mods.flags |= Flags.FINAL;
106: 		
107: 		boolean markStatic = true;

112: 			if ((typeDecl.mods.flags & (Flags.INTERFACE | Flags.ANNOTATION)) != 0) markStatic = false;

116:
